Excellent Dishes at Hue Corner
Jun 2022
Hue Corner is one of the most delicious Vietnamese restaurants ever encountered. We have been there on several occasions, as a couple, or with friends. We absolutely love their stir fry beef and onions, to which I add soy sauce with chopped up chilis, the chicken leg with a glaze of some sort, the deep fried spring rolls, morning glory with garlic, and garlic fried rice. My husband and I usually share this although if we are with friends we have an even greater selection to choose from. Neither if us like fish sauce, nor our friends so we always have these dishes without fish sauce. But believe me they are all exceptionally delicious. The staff are friendly and helpful and it is always a very pleasant experience. We would go to Hue Corner more often but now we live in D7. However we will still make the effort to go to Hue Corner in Thao Dien, as the food is so exceptional.

This restaurant sells dirty, unhygienic food and does not respect such customers
Sep 2019 • Family
Today we had breakfast here and encountered something horrible. At first the staff brought us a plate of raw vegetables with lots of hair in it. We complained and asked to change another plate of vegetables when the staff looked uncomfortable and presented another plate of vegetables. When we were eating, we found a worm or a flukes crawling in a dish of vegetables. We asked to meet the restaurant owner, but they still didn't bother to meet us to talk. terrible. I cannot understand why this restaurant sells dirty, unhygienic food and does not respect such customers.
